main_text.l: pl. m. Rad. נָבָה
et portassi[?] fuerint, fut. Hoph. 3. pl. m. R. נָבָה.
יִכּוֹל, & יְכֹלֶת posse, Inf. Kal, R. יָכַל.
יִכּוֹן stabilietur, יִכּוֹנוּ confirmabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. כּוֹן.
וַיִּכּוֹנֵנִי et constituerunt me, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. כּוּן.
וַיִּכּוֹנְנוּ et parabunt se, Ps. 49. 5. fut. Hithp. 3. pl. m. R. כּוּן.
יִכָּחֵד celabitur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. כָּחַד.
וַיִּכְחָשׁוּ et mendaces fient, fut. Niph. 3. pl. masc. Rad. כָּחַשׁ.
יְכִיחֶךָּ arguet te, fut. Hiph. 3. sing. m. aff. Rad. יָכַח.
יָכִיל continebit, יְכִילֻנוּ eum, יָכִילוּ capient, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. & 3. pl. m. R. כּוּל.
וַיָּבִינוּ et parārunt, fut.
Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. כּוֹן.
יָכִיר agnoscet, יְכִירֶנּוּ eum, יְכִירָהּ eam, יְכִירוּם eos, &c. fut. Hiph. 3. f. & pl. m. aff. R. נָכַר.
יִכָּלֶה consumatur, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. R. כָּלָה.
וַיְכַל et absolvit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. apoc. Rad. כַּלָּה.
יָכֹל poterit, יֻכְלוּ, יָכְלוּ poterunt, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. יָכַל.
יִכָּלֵא cohibebitur, cohibebuntur, fut. Niph. 3. f. & pl. m. R. כָּלָא.
יִכְלָה occludet, Gen. 23. 6. pro יִכְלָא, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. Rad. כָּלָא.
יָכְלָה potuit, præt. Kal, 3. sing. fæm. Rad. יָכַל.
וַיִּכְלְאוּ et absumunt eum, fut. Piel, 3. pl. m. aff. Rad. כָּלָה.
יָכְלוּ potuerunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. m. R. יָכַל.

page.notes: Hebrew words are copied from the scan with vowel points as far as they are legible; the Hebrew letters in the running head and the Hebrew lines marked [?] are uncertain. The left column's Latin word "portassi" is doubtful and marked. Several Hebrew forms in the right column (e.g. יְכִירֶנּוּ, יְכִירָהּ) are read from a small, smudged scan and may carry errors in their points. The line "וַיָּבִינוּ et parārunt" is partly cut off at the column foot and is read with some doubt.
